title: Soccer/football play-by-play
hook: A group of academics has partnered with a soccer-data company to publish what they believe to be “the largest collection of soccer-logs ever released.” The dataset describes every “event” on the field — each pass, shot, foul, tackle, penalty, and more — for the 2017/18 season of five European leagues, the 2018 World Cup, and the 2016 European championship.
